milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find/locate' task where the player must navigate to and observe the polished andesite structure. Target [7, 1, 9] is the center of the 3x3x3 polished andesite wall placed with '/fill ~6 ~0 ~8 ~8 ~2 ~10'. max_distance=10 requires the agent to walk at least ~1.4 blocks toward the target (since spawn-to-target distance is ~11.4 blocks), preventing accidental completion from spawn. facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actively looking at the polished andesite, confirming intentional observation.
